contact_desc: Bug reports, feature requests, questions about the app — feel free to send them our way.
contact_email_note: Enter it if you'd like a reply.
contact_message_ph: Please be as specific as you can. For bugs, it helps to include where it happened and the steps you took.
contact_file_note: Image, video, PDF, or text — up to 25MB.
contact_success_desc: Thank you for reaching out. We'll review your message and get back to you if a reply is needed.
contact_error: Sending failed. Please wait a moment and try again.
contact_privacy_note: Your message is used only to respond to your inquiry.
contact_meta_desc: Contact Ripen, the focus and study habit app for Android. Send bug reports, feature requests or questions about the app.
